questions.q: What does a multimodal (vision) model accept in one message?
options: Text and images, and it answers in text
questions.why: You send a question and an image together; the answer is text.

questions.q: How do you add an image to a ChatClient prompt?
questions.why: The image is a Media: a MIME type plus a Resource (or a URL), on the user message.

questions.q: Which local Ollama model in the course can read images?
questions.why: ollama show gemma3:4b lists the vision capability.

questions.q: The model read 'BRICO' as 'Brico' and could misread a digit. What did the lab do?
options: Validate: the lines plus tax must equal the total (addsUp)
questions.why: Check what you can compute, and let the user confirm before saving.

questions.q: Why use temperature 0 for receipt extraction?
options: You want to copy data, not be creative: the same answer every time
